title: Opinion: The future is personalized custom games and not app stores.
author: Only-Cheetah-9579
selftext:
The way things are going, I really think personalized apps and games are going to be the future. Custom tailored experiences for the user. 

Building games to sell to others gonna change big time. 

For single player experiences we can create our own worlds just for ourselves.

With this I see less and less need for app stores and game developers.

The network effects and shared games will stick around but people will gravitate only to AAA games or some very special indie titles ,like they mostly do already, while the smaller publishers will generally be even less successful, just because the lack of network effects won't drive customers who now have the option to have a custom experience tailored to them. 

Same way you can get shoes tailored, you can get games tailored to your specifications. 

Why would you wait for the next episode of your favorite game when you can just generate it?
